# plakar_data_class (Resource)

An organization data class, one name in the list the Classification page shows. New organizations come with personal_data, sensitive_personal_data, health_records, cardholder_data, financial_records, employee_records, audit_logs, intellectual_property, business_data and system_state; those can be deleted like any other, so to manage one, import it first: creating a name that already exists is an error, because the server would answer as if it had created it and a later destroy would delete a value Terraform never made. Names are kept exactly as written, case and spaces included, so Prod and prod are two data classs. There is no update: changing the name replaces. Destroying the resource removes the name for the whole organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "plakar_data_class" "contracts" {
  name = "contracts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the data class. Changing it replaces.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Id of the organization. Defaults to the provider's organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data class name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <name>, in the provider's organization
terraform import plakar_data_class.personal_data personal_data
```
